summary: Phase-1 verification of Visibility Kit visual panel + admin tile + R9-gate. Backend: state endpoint returns apply_enabled:false with R9 reason; apply endpoint returns 403 with R9 message; admin dashboard returns honest citation placeholder (no fake %). Existing pytest suite (14 tests in test_visibility_kit_v2_2026_08_30.py) all PASS. Frontend: Kit tab opens panel, donut+summary+banner render, all 7 rows present, main CTA + all 5 per-row Apply buttons disabled with R9 tooltip, clicking disabled Apply does NOT open confirm modal, advisory View report modal works, badge preview contains Google's real SDK URL + preferred-source-btn div + preferences/source deeplink, X close returns to Chat. Admin /admin/visibility-kit initially crashed with 'Element type is invalid' React error because the visibility_kit id was missing from the iconMap passed to buildGroupedAdminNav in Admin.jsx — undefined Icon component. Fixed by importing Sparkles from lucide-react and adding visibility_kit: Sparkles to the iconMap. After fix, admin page renders correctly and citation section shows the honest placeholder 'No citation data yet — day-14 recheck pending (~Sept 11).'

Backend also correctly returns 403 with 'apply_not_yet_enabled' before hitting the billing gate. Good.

rca of the issue: Admin.jsx line 1752 calls buildGroupedAdminNav(iconMap) but the iconMap object did not include an entry for the new nav id 'visibility_kit' added in adminNav.js line 29. buildGroupedAdminNav returns { Icon: iconMap[item.id] } which evaluates to undefined. Admin.jsx then renders `<Icon size={14} />` for each nav row → React 'Element type is invalid' error → RouteErrorBoundary catches → 'Something went wrong loading this page.' shown to user. Fix: import Sparkles from lucide-react and add `visibility_kit: Sparkles,` to the iconMap object. Verified: after fix, /admin/visibility-kit renders the full dashboard including data-testid=admin-visibility-kit-dashboard and data-testid=admin-kit-citation-section with the honest placeholder text.
